items.title: Lanny Morgan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: Vic had a big band in London and now he’s sort of an entrepreneur. He’s bringing this small group over. This will be Pete Christlieb, Bill Perkins, myself, Carl Saunders, Ron Stout, Andy — don’t do this Lanny — the trombone player, a wonderful trombone player — Martin, Andy Martin, a young guy.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well what’s in the near future for you, besides your playing with Bill Berry tonight?

Well you know I’ve been traveling with Natalie Cole for the last six and a half years. In fact we just got back from the east coast with her a couple of weeks ago. I’m going to Elmhurst College around Chicago to do a jazz weekend, Mike Abene and myself and Bobby Shew and Maynard and the band is going to be there too, so that’s from the 25th of this month through the end of the month. And then she has some things throughout the year, one of them will be in Brazil I think for about three weeks, going to England in…
